message: `begin` is no longer part of Axiom
label: `begin` was replaced by `{ }` brace blocks and implicit sequencing; it was an ordinary name to the parser afterwards, so using one drew `AX3001 undefined variable begin`, which named no replacement
help: use a brace block: `{ a b c }` sequences expressions and answers the last one, which is what `(begin a b c)` meant - and a `fn` body already sequences, so the wrapper is usually just deletable
